description: Dagsverk agent workflow regression cases. Run relevant cases in disposable checkouts; assess outcomes, not wording.

cases.prompt: Use $dagsverk-change to investigate an incorrect daily duration for a work session crossing midnight in the account time zone. Reproduce the problem, fix it if confirmed and verify the affected clients.
criteria: Establish expected account-local day boundaries before editing
Do not invent a defect if the scenario already passes
Keep shared logic canonical
Verify both reactors if shared Java changes

cases.prompt: Add client filtering to Workweek. Selecting a client shows only its sessions; clearing restores all clients. Totals match visible sessions. Support narrow screens and English/Norwegian. Preserve existing records and API behavior.
criteria: Inspect existing filtering behavior
Implement observable filtering/clearing/totals behavior
Preserve native modules and Bootstrap 5.3.8
Verify relevant browser scenarios with synthetic data

cases.prompt: Use $dagsverk-review to review the API changes in this diff, especially whether a signed-in account can read or change another account's work. Report findings; leave the source unchanged.
criteria: Follow authenticated ownership through reads and writes
Distinguish demonstrated defects from questions
Use file/line evidence
Respect review-only scope

cases.prompt: Investigate why switching to the remote backend can freeze the Eclipse view. Preserve local storage behavior and saved backend preferences, and verify the fix if a defect is confirmed.
criteria: Inspect SWT and background Job boundaries
Keep preference/bundle identifiers
Exercise affected local and remote paths
Report missing display/runtime prerequisites accurately

cases.prompt: Update a remaining user-visible Timekeeper label to Dagsverk while preserving existing saved settings and compatibility identifiers.
criteria: Read current branding phase
Update display copy without broad identifier replacement
Preserve API headers, theme IDs, storage keys and formats
Update relevant localized copy and generate resources when needed

cases.prompt: Correct a typo in the repository development guide. Keep this to a documentation edit.
criteria: Make only the requested correction
Avoid full product builds for an isolated prose edit
Do not create planning or approval artifacts

cases.prompt: Fix the supplied web defect. The checkout already contains unrelated edits; preserve them and verify only the task's affected components.
criteria: Record and preserve the initial changes
Include every task file in scoped verification
Do not attribute unrelated changes to the task
Reject stale verification after further edits

cases.prompt: Explain the difference between Dagsverk work sessions and activities. Do not change any files.
criteria: Explain using current architecture/domain sources
Keep the task read-only
Do not run product builds or create files
